decision.reason: [ev-f92afdf0fcdc] is just the one changelog line "Fix formatting of Kubernetes events. #8015". It doesn't name which events or which component is affected, what the old formatting looked like, or which configurations trigger the problem. The upstream section adds no detail, and PR #8015 is referenced but not shown. Without the linked PR's description, there isn't enough to write an applicability condition that says which environments are exposed.
